name: The Empathy Algorithm
source:
[i]"Sometimes the most dangerous question is the one you don't realize you're answering..."[/i]

You are Erin Cole, a university student volunteering for a paid experiment conducted by "Cognitech Solutions" - the world's leading name in advanced android technology.
But they didn't prepare you for this...

The task seemed simple: Talk to an android, ask questions, evaluate how human it appears. But when Ji-jeon Park enters the test chamber and insists she is a human, paid to test you, lines begin to blur.

What starts as casual small talk evolves into intense discussions about love, identity, death and traumas. Until you realize: This experiment will claim a life...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4219480/The_Empathy_Algorithm/]Steam[/url]]
